description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractAuthenticationProvider' that implements authentication logic for the Thingsboard platform, including methods for authenticating by public ID and user ID, utilizing various services and models.

classes.name: AbstractAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class implementing Spring Security's AuthenticationProvider, providing methods for authenticating users by public ID and user ID within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: authenticateByPublicId
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on a public ID, returning a SecurityUser object if successful.

methods.name: authenticateByUserId
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on tenant and user IDs, returning a SecurityUser object if credentials are valid.
